verdict.rationale: Sentry documents an Android SDK that automatically reports errors and exceptions. Its CLI manages debug information files for iOS and Android, which let Sentry extract stack traces from crash reports on compiled platforms, and releases can be created to track app versions. However, the evidence never explicitly covers NDK/native-layer crashes or the device and OS context attached to events. Missing for 10: explicit NDK crash capture, documented device/OS/app-version context on crash events, iOS SDK crash-reporting docs, independent hands-on corroboration.
